cohort: Newborns with congenital anomalies at a tertiary care hospital in Guwahati, Assam, India, from January 2019 to December 2019.
finding: The incidence of congenital anomalies was 2.6% among live births, with the gastrointestinal system most commonly affected (33.8%), followed by the central nervous system (20.9%) and craniofacial system (11.7%), and gestational age, gender, and parity were significant determinants.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with congenital anomalies in univariate analysis, but not in the final regression model.
